privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.intro_body: HANOTI POS ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect through the HANOTI POS application ("the App"), how we use it, how we store and protect it, and the choices you have. By registering, logging in, or using the App, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.
privacy_policy.collect_body:
To provide the point-of-sale service, we collect the following data:

• Account data: your phone number (used as your login identifier), your full name, and your store name.
• Store information: store address, store phone number, and tax ID, which you may add in Settings and which appear on printed invoices.
• Business data: product names, categories, prices, quantities, barcodes, minimum stock levels, sales transactions (items, quantities, totals), payment methods, optional customer names and phones, and inventory movements.
• Subscription data: your subscription plan and its start and end dates.
• Device data: camera access for barcode scanning and short audio feedback (a beep) on successful scans.
privacy_policy.use_body: We use the collected data to: operate and maintain the App; process sales and returns; manage products and inventory; generate invoices and receipts; provide sales analytics and dashboards; sync your data across your devices; check subscription status; improve our services; and comply with legal obligations. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy_policy.storage_body: Your data is stored locally on your device using offline-first storage so the App works without an internet connection. When you are online and signed in, your data is synchronized with Firebase (Firebase Auth, Firestore, and Storage), which is hosted on secure cloud servers. Data sync happens only for the account that is currently signed in.
privacy_policy.camera_body: The App requests access to your camera solely to scan product barcodes at the point of sale and in inventory management. We do not record, store, or upload any camera images. The App may also play a short beep sound for scan feedback.
privacy_policy.sharing_body: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data. Data is shared only with service providers that help operate the App (such as Firebase for authentication, database, and storage) and only to the extent necessary to provide the service. We may disclose data if required by law or to protect our rights, safety, or property.
privacy_policy.security_body: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including secure connections and restricted access to the databases that store your information. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy_policy.retention_body: We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as long as necessary to provide the service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. You can delete your local data by clearing the App data or uninstalling the App; server data can be removed by contacting us.
privacy_policy.rights_body: You have the right to access, correct, or request the deletion of your personal data. You can update your store information in the Settings screen and manage your account. To request access to or deletion of your data, contact us using the contact information below.
privacy_policy.children_body: The App is intended for use by businesses and adults operating a store. It is not directed at children under the age of 13 (or the applicable minimum age in your country). We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.
privacy_policy.changes_body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Your continued use of the App after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.
privacy_policy.contact_body: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, you can reach us through the support options available in the App or by contacting us directly. We will respond to your request as soon as reasonably possible.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro_body: These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of the HANOTI POS application ("the App"). By creating an account, logging in, or using the App, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree with any part of these Terms, you must not use the App.
terms.service_body: HANOTI POS provides a point-of-sale (POS) system that enables you to: manage products and inventory; process sales and returns; track inventory movements; scan product barcodes; generate, print, share, and save invoices and receipts; view sales analytics and dashboards; and manage your store information. The service operates offline-first with optional cloud synchronization.
terms.account_body: To use the App you must create an account using a valid phone number and a secure password. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information and to update it when necessary. You must not share your credentials with unauthorized persons.
terms.subscription_body: The App includes a free trial period of seven (7) days from the date of registration. After the trial period, continued use requires an active subscription. Subscriptions are billed according to the plan you select. We may modify subscription plans, pricing, or features at any time, and we will notify you of material changes. If your subscription expires, access to the App will be restricted until it is renewed.
terms.use_body: You agree to use the App only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms. You must not: misuse the App or attempt to disrupt its operation; use the App to process fraudulent transactions; reverse engineer, copy, or reproduce any part of the App; upload malicious code or content; or attempt to access another user's account or data.
terms.accuracy_body: You are responsible for the accuracy of the products, prices, quantities, and other data you enter into the App. Prices and stock levels are managed by you and reflected in your sales and receipts. We are not responsible for errors in the data you enter.
terms.ip_body: The App, including its code, design, graphics, logos, and all related content, is owned by HANOTI and is protected by intellectual property laws. You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the App for your business purposes. You may not use HANOTI's name or logos without our written permission.
terms.privacy_body: Your use of the App is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your data. By using the App, you consent to the practices described in the Privacy Policy.
terms.liability_body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, HANOTI shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including loss of profits, data, or business opportunities, arising out of or related to your use of the App. The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied.
terms.termination_body: We may suspend or terminate your access to the App at any time if you violate these Terms, or if required by law. Upon termination, your right to use the App ceases immediately. You may stop using the App at any time and delete your account by contacting us. Provisions of these Terms that by their nature should survive termination will survive.
terms.changes_body: We may revise these Terms from time to time. Changes become effective when posted in the App. Your continued use of the App after changes take effect constitutes your acceptance of the revised Terms.
terms.law_body: These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria. Any disputes arising under these Terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts of Algeria.
